patterns.note: Dramatic full-bleed hero image with large, elegant text overlays that dominate the initial viewport.
A full-width, horizontally scrolling image carousel is used to present a sequence of visual content below the hero.
A high-contrast color scheme shifts dramatically from a dark background with light text (hero and footer) to a light background with dark text (interior content pages).
Elegant serif typography is used for prominent display headings, creating a sophisticated feel, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
The initial page load reveals the hero section with a subtle fade-in effect, transitioning from a black screen to the full-bleed image and text.

technique_notes: The initial page load employs a full-screen overlay that fades out to reveal the dramatic full-bleed hero image and its overlaid text content.

The primary navigation bar dynamically adjusts its visual style, appearing as transparent with light text when positioned over the hero image, and transitioning to an opaque white background with dark text on interior content pages.
Visual content is presented within a full-width, horizontally scrolling image carousel, featuring clear navigation arrows for user interaction.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) provide a strong visual statement, while body text uses a clean, readable sans-serif.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with airy sections in the hero and content pages, providing ample whitespace around text blocks.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dramatic, almost cinematic opening, where an initial black screen gives way to a full-bleed hero image with large, elegant typography. This creates a powerful first impression that feels more like a film title sequence than a typical website load, setting a sophisticated and artistic tone.
